courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 上海中心大廈
related.transfer: 可遷移「尖峰交通需求與服務指標」與「往返時間計算與交通模擬」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；上海中心大廈的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Peak traffic demand and service metrics" and "Round-trip-time calculation and traffic simulation" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Shanghai Tower must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以尖峰人流、分區轉乘、曳引極限與派梯演算法，讓超高層垂直運輸在有限核心筒內達到服務目標；上海中心大廈則以巨型框架、核心筒與外伸臂三重體系，配合扭轉外形、軟土深基礎與柔性懸掛帷幕的整合設計為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on peak demand, tiered zoning, traction limits and dispatch algorithms that let supertall vertical transport meet service targets within a limited core; Shanghai Tower centres on A mega-frame, core and outrigger triple system integrated with a twisting form, deep soft-ground foundations and a flexibly hung façade, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上行尖峰人口」與「120° 扭轉外形」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到上海中心大廈，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「軟土中的長樁與樁端後注漿驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Up-peak population” and “120-degree twist”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Shanghai Tower, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 超高層電梯分區與調度
history.titleEn: Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings
history.text: 1854 年 Elisha Otis 在紐約水晶宮展示安全煞車，使載人電梯得以普及，高樓從此能往上發展。1960 至 1970 年代興建的原世界貿易中心雙塔把每棟分成三段，以 44 與 78 樓空中大廳轉乘，確立超高層「直達穿梭加區間電梯」的分區模式；1990 年 Schindler 推出 Miconic 10 目的樓層派梯系統，把派梯決策移到乘客進入車廂之前。2000 年代之後，台北 101、上海中心大廈與廣州周大福金融中心相繼刷新電梯速度紀錄，碳纖維曳引索則挑戰單段行程限制。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: In 1854 Elisha Otis demonstrated his safety brake at the New York Crystal Palace, making passenger lifts acceptable and letting buildings grow taller. The original World Trade Center towers, built in the 1960s and 1970s, split each tower into three tiers with sky lobbies on floors 44 and 78, establishing the supertall pattern of express shuttles plus local elevators; in 1990 Schindler launched Miconic 10, a destination-control system that moved the dispatch decision to before passengers board. Since the 2000s Taipei 101, Shanghai Tower and Guangzhou CTF Finance Centre have each set elevator speed records, and carbon-fibre hoisting ropes have challenged the single-run travel limit. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
